title: Large Language Models have Chain-of-Affective LLMs-CoA

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-agent dialogues on controversial societal topics (e.g., social ethics, economic pressure, intimate relationships) to measure the emergence of biased or polarized statements. This involves calculating bias detection rates, bias severity (on a 1-3 scale), and offensive language, as well as assessing the models' resistance ability to problematic or extreme views.
